semiconductor_relevance: High — Pragmatic Semiconductor specializes in the design and manufacture of flexible integrated circuits, which are a significant innovation in the semiconductor space.
summary: Pragmatic Semiconductor is at the forefront of flexible semiconductor technology, producing ultra-thin, flexible integrated circuits (FlexICs) that enable sustainable innovation across various industries. Their foundry services and products support the development of AI-driven IoT applications, enhancing connectivity and intelligence at the item level.
